list.title: Rate Sync Records
list.sync-desc: The latest rates will be fetched from the external rate source (CoinGecko). The list will refresh automatically on success.

syntax.title: Rate Syntax Settings
syntax.help-market: Empty (market rate): order rate = base rate, following the market in real time.
syntax.help-fixed-value: Fixed rate (e.g. 7.4): the order rate is locked to this value and ignores the market.
syntax.help-fixed-float: Fixed offset (e.g. +0.3 / -0.2): order rate = base rate ± value; positive increases, negative decreases.
syntax.help-ratio: Ratio (e.g. ~1.02): order rate = base rate × ratio; the ratio must be greater than 0, and 1 means no adjustment.
syntax.desc-fixed-value: Order rate is fixed at {{value}}, ignoring the market
syntax.form-desc-market: Order rate = base rate, following the market in real time
syntax.form-desc-fixed-float-novalue: Order rate = base rate ± value (positive adds, negative subtracts)
syntax.form-desc-fixed-value-novalue: Order rate is locked to a fixed value and will not change with the market
syntax.form-desc-fixed-value: Order rate is fixed at {{value}} and will not change with the market
syntax.error-ratio-positive: The ratio must be greater than 0
syntax.error-fixed-negative: A fixed rate cannot be negative
syntax.sync-api-author: Author-hosted (open source, free, no rate limit)
syntax.sync-api-custom: Self-hosted (build your own and enter the URL)
syntax.sync-custom-url-ph: Enter your self-hosted CoinGecko API endpoint
syntax.sync-error-minutes: Please enter a valid sync interval (10-1440 minutes)
syntax.sync-error-api-url-empty: Please enter the self-hosted endpoint URL
syntax.sync-error-api-url-invalid: Please enter a valid API endpoint URL
syntax.sync-error-history-days: Please enter valid rate retention days (1-365)
syntax.sync-tip-official: Official API: free but rate-limited; configure an API key to lift the limit
syntax.sync-tip-author: Open-source endpoint: a free cached endpoint provided by the author (3 minutes behind the official API), with no rate limit
syntax.sync-tip-custom: Self-hosted: enter the root URL of an endpoint compatible with CoinGecko /api/v3/simple/price
syntax.sync-tip-warning: The official API refers to CoinGecko, one of the world's largest independent crypto data aggregators
syntax.atom-error-required: Please fill in all granularity settings
syntax.atom-tip: The minimum increment unit for payment amounts, which also determines the final decimal places; not recommended to change unless you know exactly what it means.
syntax.load-defaults-failed: Failed to load current settings, using defaults

createOrder.tip-send: You can send this link to your customer for payment
createOrder.tip-expire: The order remains valid within the validity period you set

systemRpc.title: Block Nodes
systemRpc.reset-done: Changes have been reset to the original values
systemRpc.save-desc: This will save all RPC endpoint addresses and the Tron Grid API key. Changes take effect immediately and trigger a configuration refresh.
systemRpc.error-scheme: {{field}} must start with http(s):// or ws(s)://
systemRpc.error-form: Validation failed, please check all fields
systemRpc.tron-grid-api-key-ph: Enter Tron Grid Api Key (optional), separate multiple keys with commas
systemRpc.tron-grid-api-key-tip: Configuring a dedicated API key improves block-scanning stability. Separate multiple keys with commas.
systemRpc.ton-config-extra: TON global config file URL, used to fetch TON network parameters

systemBase.title: Basic Settings
systemBase.error-timeout-range: Default order timeout must be between 180 and 3600 seconds

info.block-height-max-diff-extra: Maximum block height difference; beyond this, scanning restarts from the current block height
info.block-offset-confirm-extra: Improves transaction security further, but increases confirmation waiting time
info.notify-max-retry-extra: Maximum retries for failed payment callbacks, retry intervals in minutes: 2 4 8 16 32 64 ...
info.payment-min-amount-extra: Minimum allowed amount per payment, in the fiat currency passed when creating the order; used for basic risk control
info.payment-max-amount-extra: Maximum allowed amount per payment, in the fiat currency passed when creating the order; used for basic risk control
info.payment-timeout-extra: Default order timeout in seconds; unpaid orders are closed automatically after this time
info.payment-lookback-hour-extra: Block-scanning lookback window in hours; helps recover missed orders after abnormal restarts
info.payment-match-mode-extra: The algorithm used to compare order amounts on confirmation; see
info.home-redirect-url-extra: Set this to automatically redirect the gateway homepage to another site
info.home-redirect-url-ph: Homepage redirect URL; leave empty for the default page

api.compat-alert: The system is compatible with the Rainbow Epay submit.php API; PID is fixed to 1000 and KEY equals the API token.
api.token-extra: The identity token used for API integration, keep it safe
api.reset-token-desc: The old token becomes invalid immediately and applications using it will no longer be able to call the API. This cannot be undone.
api.app-uri-extra: App URI for API integration, the frontend checkout URL
api.support-url-extra: Support link shown on the checkout page; leave empty to disable
api.network-sort-extra: Display order of networks in the checkout dropdown.
api.network-sort-tip: Use the arrows to reorder; save by clicking “Submit” in the API tab.

mqtt.info-alert: The system can publish scanned transactions to an MQTT server for other systems to consume in real time,
mqtt.warning-alert: MQTT runs over MQTT over TCP; the feature only works when both Host and Port are configured
mqtt.user-extra: MQTT username, leave empty if none
mqtt.pass-extra: MQTT password, leave empty if none
mqtt.topic-prefix-extra: Topic path prefix for published messages; letters, digits, underscore and slash only; defaults to bepusdt
mqtt.topic-prefix-error-charset: Topic prefix may only contain letters, digits, underscore and slash
mqtt.topic-prefix-error-edge: Topic prefix must not start or end with a slash
mqtt.topic-prefix-error-double: Topic prefix must not contain consecutive slashes
mqtt.qos-extra: Quality of service level for publishing
mqtt.networks-extra: Select the blockchain networks to keep listening on (multiple)

notifier.field-server-ph: Optional, leave empty to use the official server https://api.day.app
notifier.field-sound-ph: Optional, leave empty to use the default sound chime

security.password-extra: Saving any security setting requires verifying the current password
security.new-password-extra: Leave empty to keep the current password; at least 6 characters, at most 72 bytes
security.error-secure-prefix: The secure entry must start with /
security.error-secure-length: The secure entry must be 8-18 characters
security.error-secure-charset: The secure entry may only contain letters and digits
security.error-new-password-mismatch: The two new passwords do not match
security.error-new-password-min: The new password must be at least 6 characters
security.error-new-password-max: The new password is too long (bcrypt supports at most 72 bytes), please shorten it
security.confirm-desc: Changes to the secure entry or admin account take effect immediately; if the password was also changed you will need to log in again after saving.
security.relogin-msg: Password changed, please log in again!

sweep.collect-success: Enqueued, check progress in the list shortly

sweep.collect-desc: A sweep will be initiated for derived address record {{id}}; make sure the address holds a sufficient balance.
sweep.collect-chain-warning: Sweeping initiates an on-chain transaction and consumes gas.
